title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04
lineage: ? > PCM > played through HHb CDR800 for digital signal lock > DAT (probably Panasonic SV3500 or SV3700). DAT > PCM-M1 > S/Pdif > Protools 4.1.1 > Audiomedia III PCI card > Powermac G3/266 > Protools 4.1.1 > AIFF > Powermac G4 MDD/ Dual 1.42 > Audacity 1.2.6 (tracking in 1/75 second increments) > AIFF\'s > xACT 1.64 > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with decent clarity captures a solid show highlighted by the return of Stagger Lee and strong first‑set performances.
ai_review.review: The tape, recorded from the crowd, offers a lively ambience though the treble is bright and Phil’s bass sits low in the mix. Musically the concert delivers a fun first set with “The Stranger,” “Row Jimmy” and the surprise revival of “Stagger Lee,” while the second set opens oddly but remains solid overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Three positive reviews (4‑5 stars) praise the performance and ambience; one strongly negative review drags the average down, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High treble presence; Phil’s bass is very low in the mix. Crowd ambience adds character but some balance issues are noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is fun and well‑paced; second set is solid but opens with an oddly placed song that some found puzzling.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is very low in the mix, making it hard to hear his lines clearly.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) was “going off” on tour add‑libbing and vocal improvisations throughout the show.
